request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and reflective, soft piano, acoustic guitar, cello, strings, steady worship rhythm, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Live at peace with everyone if you can
Leave room for the wrath that God takes
Vengeance is mine, I will repay
The Lord has spoken, we obey

[Pre-Chorus]
If your enemy is hungry, feed him
If he is thirsty, give him drink
Do this and you will heap
Burning coals upon his head

[Chorus]
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good

[Verse]
As far as it depends on you
Choose the path of peace today
Do not take revenge, dear friends
Trust the judgment God will pay

[Chorus]
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good

[Bridge]
Feed the hungry, give the drink
Let the burning coals arise
Evil cannot win the war
When your response is love and grace

[Chorus]
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good
Do not be overcome by evil
But overcome evil with good
